title: Can Stocks Keep Defying High Rates?
summary: Stocks continue to push higher even as interest rates climb, but how long can that divergence last? Andrew Wilkinson and Interactive Brokers Chief Market Strategist Steve Sosnick discuss rising global yields, AI-driven market concentration, pressure on banks, and why the market may be more fragile beneath the surface.
